title: 福特CEO谈勒芒回归与电动皮卡
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Welcome. We have a very special guest today to mark the Thanksgiving holiday. Jim Farley, the CEO of Ford joins us from Detroit, Michigan and Jim. It's great to have you on the program.
segments.zh: 欢迎。今天我们请到一位特别嘉宾来庆祝感恩节。福特CEO吉姆·法利从密歇根州底特律加入我们。吉姆，很高兴你能来参加节目。

segments.en: I know as the CEO, you're oftentimes in stress, oftentimes putting out fires, but because of the season, I want to start out by asking you, asking you what you are thankful for
segments.zh: 我知道作为CEO，你经常压力很大，经常要处理紧急问题，但因为这个季节，我想先问你，这个感恩节你感恩什么？

segments.en: this Thanksgiving. I'm thankful that Ford is going back to Le Mans to be Ferrari in the best of the world
segments.zh: 这个感恩节，我感恩福特重返勒芒，在世界顶级赛事中与法拉利一较高下。

segments.en: and there will be announcing it today on Thanksgiving.
segments.zh: 而且今天感恩节就会宣布这个消息。

segments.en: It is the 60th anniversary of your first win at Le Mans with the GT 40, made famous, of
segments.zh: 这是你们首次在勒芒夺冠60周年，当时驾驶的是GT40，这款车因电影《福特大战法拉利》而闻名。

segments.en: course, most recently by the movie Ford versus Ferrari. And you then won, I think what, four years in a row right, 66, 67, 68, and 69, that car won. It took you a couple years
segments.zh: 然后你们连续赢了四年，对吧？66、67、68、69年，那辆车都赢了。你们花了几年时间才登上最高领奖台。

segments.en: to get, to get, to get on the top step, though. You raised that car in 63, 64 and 65, I should
segments.zh: 我应该说是63、64和65年你们推出了那辆车。

segments.en: say. How do you think you're going to fare in your first year with this new GT 40, which you're calling the GT 41?
segments.zh: 你觉得你第一年用这款新的GT40——你称之为GT41——会表现如何？

segments.en: Well, great question. We're really excited to go back. It's been a long time. We did win
segments.zh: 好问题。我们非常兴奋能重返赛场。已经很久了。几年前我们确实在GT组别赢过。

segments.en: with in the GT class a few years ago, but winning Le Mans outright as an all-American effort is really something. Look, we just finished our 30-hour test today. Just talked to the drivers.
segments.zh: 但作为全美车队在勒芒 outright 夺冠确实意义重大。看，我们今天刚完成30小时测试，刚和车手们谈过。
